Text link used for wayfinding — breadcrumbs and in-page section navigation. The current variant marks the active destination and stays interactive in a persistent nav (e.g. scrolls to itself); it is not used for the active crumb in a breadcrumb trail, which renders as plain non-interactive text instead.
